zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.shortDesc: 以对话式工作流剪辑视频并生成字幕、动画叠层；转录会将素材音频发送至 ElevenLabs Scribe，需 API 密钥（可能另收费）；需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg/ffprobe。

en-US.name: video-use
en-US.shortDesc: Edit videos and create subtitles/animation overlays conversationally. Transcription sends source audio to ElevenLabs Scribe; an API key is required and usage may incur separate charges. Requires Python 3.10+ and ffmpeg/ffprobe.
